name: editorial-shutter
title: Editorial Shutter
description: A one-time crop for inert decorative media that opens from a chosen alignment edge with a complete static fallback.

accessibility.notes: The API accepts decorative media only and renders it inert and aria-hidden, so clipped focusables cannot occur. Reduced motion skips the crop transition.

performance.budget: One bounded clip-path transition on mount; no script, observer, timer, or animation loop.
